blockingLoop.evidence: Asked about timing/cut-out again after the customer already gave 2-5 minutes; final turn asks 'Could you tell me a bit more about what it is doing, and when it happens?' after everything was already explained

rationale: The assistant correctly said early on that the fan run-on is probably normal, and the final message reaches the right conclusion, with the sensible caveat that a fan running constantly when cold would be worth a closer look. In between, it asked irrelevant questions (conventional vs inverter, 'cut out' timing) that ignored what the customer had already said. The ending is weak: it concludes 'normal' but then asks the customer to explain again what is happening, and it quotes a 10-30 minute run-on that does not match the customer's 2-5 minutes. No part was recommended and there was no unsafe advice.
